adaptations: Host-verified TLS and bounded payloads. Fixed IYUU origin. Unknown downloader mutation outcomes stop automatic continuation. The log sink removes URLs and remote diagnostic bodies.

Origin, snapshot and current SDK call bind tracker requests. M-Team token POST is fixed and does not follow redirects. Aliased material GET uses one exact request grant per response, without site credentials. Catalog-only entries lack an authorized transport. Standard M-Team UTF-8 JSON is supported for alias grant issuance.
Torrent file cache and invalid URL TTL use the instance-owned path and process rather than the original shared FileCache and global invalid URL state.
Private interval/date keep source time, grace and ownership but serialize business passes for shared config/queue safety. Delayed jobs may misfire. Long active work can delay reinitialization.
No one-shot state was imported, no old MoviePilot or live production tracker/downloader was modified.
